plugin.name: Anthropic (Claude)
plugin.description: An Anthropic connection for AI features: API key kept in the keychain, model, effort and output limit.
field.secret.hint: Written to the keychain only; never shown again.
field.fallback: Use the fallback model when a reply is refused
field.fallback.hint: Sonnet and Opus only; Haiku has no server-side fallback.
note.host: Only {host} can be reached through this connection.
error.badUrl: The address must start with http:// or https://.
error.auth: The API key was not accepted
error.tooLong: The input is too long for the model
error.badAnswer: The answer could not be read.
error.userInfo: The address must not contain a user name or password (user@host).
error.insecure: A remote address must use https://. Plain http:// is only allowed for this machine (127.0.0.1, localhost, [::1]).
